findings.what: The worker-side President identity blocker still misses valid President aliases such as bare "Alex" and the Greek call-sign "α".
findings.why: isPresidentIdentity() normalizes to ASCII letters and only blocks alpha/alexalpha/president forms. In this repo, AGENTS.md defines Alex as the President identity and α as the President office call-sign, but deriveBinding({channel:'dispatch-claude', role:'Alex'}) and role:'α' return ok:false/failClosed:false rather than a fail-closed President-identity refusal. Both dispatch bridges only refuse ok:false when failClosed is true, so these aliases can still be spawned as dispatched workers, with dispatch-claude also injecting them into the worker preamble as the role string. That violates the R2 requirement that all President aliases remain blocked as workers.
